$comment: Advisories accepted for a limited time. Each needs a reason (also in docs/security.md, Supply chain) and an expiry date; scripts/audit-deps.mjs fails again after it. Keep in step with .trivyignore.

exceptions.reason: Moderate denial of service from crafted glob patterns. Used only by the ESLint toolchain in development, on glob patterns from our own configuration; never in the running application. Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1 (2026-10-27), which ESLint does not use yet.
